title: Hearty Mexican Fish Tacos
description: A dense and flavorful Mexican dish featuring chopped onion and deep-fry tofu, perfect for a brunch mood, with a pescatarian-friendly twist and a hint of mustardy flavor.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Deep-fry the tofu cubes until golden brown and set aside.
In a separate pan, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the cod pieces to the pan and cook until they are opaque and flake easily with a fork.
In a small bowl, mix together the mustard, cumin, and paprika.
Add the mustard mixture to the cod and onion mixture and stir to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a portion of the cod mixture onto a tortilla and topping with deep-fried tofu and any desired toppings.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
